name: oassis
description: Read any page or document as markdown, map and crawl whole sites, and drive a real browser. No API key and no signup to start.

oassis.description: Web scraping, crawling and browser control for agents. Scrape a page or a PDF to markdown, get a map of every link, button and field on it, list a site's urls, crawl it, and keep a browser session open to click and type. Works with no key: a keyless caller gets a free daily allowance.
